causalAssessment.whyCandidateIsMeaningful: The hosted Web Vitals registration and scheduling frames recur in the renderer-main long-task call trees, and the exact hosted asset hash and source integration are identified.
whyCauseIsNotProven: High inclusive time is not self time: U and m themselves account for only 19.213 ms and 8.879 ms of self time in the longest task.

Browser-native addEventListener and requestIdleCallback frames carry large sampled self time; the profile alone does not resolve whether the reporter triggers, observes, or merely coexists with the busy callback path.
The trace lacks expected-action and app-visible-loading markers; the reported two-minute reload delay occurred after recording ended.
Only one saved Edge trace exists; it does not establish the cause of the full desktop-and-phone symptom across sessions or devices.
causalAssessment.conclusion: The Web Vitals reporter/hook registration and scheduling path is the strongest actionable application-code candidate in the current trace. It is not a confirmed trigger, not a proven root cause, and not a basis for a runtime fix.
